entities.name: Andreas Vokos Miaoulis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andreas Vokos, better known by his nickname Miaoulis, was a Greek revolutionary, admiral, and politician who commanded Greek naval forces during the Greek War of Independence (1821–1829).
